WITH "districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT county, district FROM "schools" WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')), "school_admin_names" AS (SELECT county, district, cdscode, admfname1 AS "first_name" FROM "schools" WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)') AND admfname1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT county, district, cdscode, admfname2 AS "first_name" FROM "schools" WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)') AND admfname2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT county, district, cdscode, admfname3 AS "first_name" FROM "schools" WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)') AND admfname3 IS NOT NULL), "name_school_counts" AS (SELECT first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) AS "school_count" FROM "school_admin_names" GROUP BY first_name), "top_names" AS (SELECT first_name FROM "name_school_counts" ORDER BY school_count DESC, first_name ASC LIMIT 2), "district_name_counts" AS (SELECT "d".district, "t".first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "san".cdscode) AS "school_count" FROM "districts" AS "d" CROSS JOIN "top_names" AS "t" LEFT JOIN "school_admin_names" AS "san" ON "san".county = "d".county AND "san".district = "d".district AND "san".first_name = "t".first_name GROUP BY "d".district, "t".first_name) SELECT district AS "district_name", first_name, school_count FROM "district_name_counts" ORDER BY district_name ASC, first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."Charter Funding Type" AS "funding_category", COUNT(*) AS "active_charter_school_count", SUM("f"."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total_k12_enrollment", ROUND(AVG("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_frpm_eligible_percentage", ROUND(AVG("s".avgscrread + "s".avgscrmath + "s".avgscrwrite)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_combined_sat_score" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "d" ON "f".cdscode = "d".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cds AND "s".rtype = 'S' WHERE "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "f"."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') AND "d".statustype = 'Active' GROUP BY "f"."Charter Funding Type" LIMIT 501

WITH "state_special" AS (SELECT "f"."School Name" AS "school_name", "f"."Low Grade" AS "low_grade", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "enrollment", CASE "f"."Low Grade" WHEN 'P' THEN 0 WHEN 'K' THEN 1 WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 4 WHEN '4' THEN 5 WHEN '5' THEN 6 WHEN '6' THEN 7 WHEN '7' THEN 8 WHEN '8' THEN 9 WHEN '9' THEN 10 WHEN '10' THEN 11 WHEN '11' THEN 12 WHEN '12' THEN 13 END AS "grade_order", "f".cdscode FROM "frpm" AS "f" WHERE "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "f"."District Type" = 'State Special Schools'), "candidates" AS (SELECT "ss".school_name, "ss".low_grade, "ss".enrollment, COALESCE("s".numtsttakr, 0) AS "sat_test_takers", "ss".grade_order FROM "state_special" AS "ss" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "ss".cdscode AND "s".rtype = 'S') SELECT school_name, low_grade, enrollment, sat_test_takers FROM "candidates" ORDER BY grade_order DESC, enrollment DESC, school_name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "school_count" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500 AND CASE "f"."High Grade" WHEN 'K' THEN 0 WHEN 'P' THEN -1 WHEN 'Adult' THEN 99 ELSE "f"."High Grade"::INTEGER END BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND "s".school IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".school) <> '' AND "s".doctype <> '00' AND COALESCE("sat".numtsttakr, 0) = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."Charter Funding Type" AS "charter_funding_type", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s".statustype = 'Active') AS "currently_operating_count", SUM("f"."Enrollment (K-12)") FILTER (WHERE "s".statustype = 'Active') AS "total_k12_enrollment", SUM("f"."FRPM Count (K-12)") FILTER (WHERE "s".statustype = 'Active') AS "total_frpm_eligible_k12_students" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'County Office of Education (COE)' AND "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "f"."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') GROUP BY "f"."Charter Funding Type" ORDER BY CASE "f"."Charter Funding Type" WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1 WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "closed_scores" AS (SELECT "sc".school, "sc".district, "sc".county, "sa".avgscrwrite FROM "schools" AS "sc" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sa" ON "sa".cds = "sc".cdscode WHERE "sc".statustype = 'Closed' AND "sa".rtype = 'S' AND "sa".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL), "ranked_scores" AS (SELECT avgscrwrite, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avgscrwrite DESC) AS "score_rank" FROM "closed_scores") SELECT "cs".school, "cs".district, "cs".county, "cs".avgscrwrite FROM "closed_scores" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "ranked_scores" AS "rs" ON "rs".avgscrwrite = "cs".avgscrwrite WHERE "rs".score_rank = 2 LIMIT 501

WITH "target_county" AS (SELECT "County Name" AS "county_name" FROM "frpm" WHERE cdscode = '01612590125716'), "eligible_schools" AS (SELECT "f".cdscode, "f"."County Name" AS "county_name", "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" AS "charter_indicator", ROUND(("f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "free_pct", ROUND(("f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "frpm_pct" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "target_county" AS "tc" ON "f"."County Name" = "tc".county_name WHERE "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700 AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0) SELECT "es".county_name AS "County Name", COUNT(*) AS "Number of Schools", ROUND(AVG("es".free_pct), 2) AS "Average Free-Meal Percentage", ROUND(AVG("es".frpm_pct), 2) AS "Average FRPM Percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "es".charter_indicator = 1) AS "Charter Schools", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "es".charter_indicator = 0) AS "Non-Charter Schools", ROUND(AVG("s".avgscrread + "s".avgscrmath + "s".avgscrwrite)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Average SAT Score" FROM "eligible_schools" AS "es" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "es".cdscode AND "s".rtype = 'S' GROUP BY "es".county_name LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / 12 AS "average_schools_per_month" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'San Diego' AND "s".opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "s".opendate < DATE '1981-01-01' AND "f"."District Type" IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".county, "s".district, "s".city, "f"."Enrollment (K-12)", "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)", "f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", "sat".numtsttakr, "sat".avgscrread, "sat".avgscrmath, "sat".avgscrwrite, "sat".numge1500 FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "s".cdscode = "sat".cds WHERE "s".cdscode = '01612590137943' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "s".cdscode, "s".school, "s".charter, "s".gsserved, "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS "free_meal_rate" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'Alameda' AND "s".gsserved ~ '(^|-)12($|-)' AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0), "top_rate" AS (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS "rate" FROM "eligible") SELECT "e".school AS "school_name", ROUND("e".free_meal_rate::NUMERIC, 4) AS "free_meal_rate", CASE WHEN "e".charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN "e".charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "charter_school", "e".gsserved AS "grades_served", CASE WHEN "sat".cds IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrread IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrmath IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "sat_performance_level" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "top_rate" AS "t" ON "e".free_meal_rate = "t".rate LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "e".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".phone, "s".website, "sat".avgscrread, "sat".avgscrmath, "sat".avgscrwrite, CASE WHEN "s".charter = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS "is_charter", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)", ROUND(("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Percent eligible FRPM (0-100)", (SELECT MAX("sat2".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "sat2" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s2" ON "s2".cdscode = "sat2".cds WHERE "s2".statustype = 'Active' AND "sat2".numtsttakr >= 10 AND "sat2".rtype = 'S') AS "highest_active_school_sat_math", (SELECT MAX("sat2".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "sat2" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s2" ON "s2".cdscode = "sat2".cds WHERE "s2".statustype = 'Active' AND "sat2".numtsttakr >= 10 AND "sat2".rtype = 'S') - "sat".avgscrmath AS "points_below_highest" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "s".cdscode = '07618040113118' LIMIT 501

WITH "virtual_schools" AS (SELECT "s".cdscode, "s".county, "s".school FROM "schools" AS "s" WHERE "s".virtual = 'F'), "county_counts" AS (SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS "virtual_school_count" FROM "virtual_schools" GROUP BY county), "ranked_counties" AS (SELECT county, virtual_school_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY virtual_school_count DESC) AS "county_rank" FROM "county_counts"), "scored_virtual" AS (SELECT "v".county, "v".school, "ss".avgscrread FROM "virtual_schools" AS "v" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "ss" ON "ss".cds = "v".cdscode AND "ss".rtype = 'S'), "maxima" AS (SELECT county, MAX(avgscrread) AS "max_reading_score" FROM "scored_virtual" GROUP BY county) SELECT "rc".county AS "county_name", "rc".virtual_school_count, COALESCE("sv".school, 'None') AS "school_name" FROM "ranked_counties" AS "rc" INNER JOIN "maxima" AS "m" ON "m".county = "rc".county LEFT JOIN "scored_virtual" AS "sv" ON "sv".county = "rc".county AND "sv".avgscrread = "m".max_reading_score WHERE "rc".county_rank <= 5 ORDER BY "rc".virtual_school_count DESC, "rc".county ASC, school_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("pa".player_api_id) "pa".player_api_id, "pa".defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" ORDER BY "pa".player_api_id ASC, "pa".date DESC, "pa".id DESC) SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "l".player_api_id WHERE "l".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'high') LIMIT 501

WITH "ever_risky" AS (SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id FROM "team_attributes" WHERE chancecreationpassingclass = 'Risky'), "on_date" AS (SELECT team_api_id, chancecreationpassing FROM "team_attributes" WHERE date = '2014-09-19 00:00:00') SELECT "t".team_short_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".team_api_id) AS "club_count", ROUND(AVG("d".chancecreationpassing)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_chance_creation_passing_risk" FROM "ever_risky" AS "r" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "r".team_api_id INNER JOIN "on_date" AS "d" ON "d".team_api_id = "r".team_api_id GROUP BY "t".team_short_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "t".team_api_id) > 1 ORDER BY average_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC, "t".team_short_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "graded_records" AS (SELECT "pa".player_api_id, "pa".defensive_work_rate, "pa".date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "pa".player_api_id ORDER BY "pa".date DESC, "pa".id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" WHERE "pa".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')) SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "graded_records" AS "gr" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "gr".player_api_id WHERE "gr".rn = 1 AND "gr".defensive_work_rate = 'medium' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("p".birthday, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1995 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".weight)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("pa".player_api_id) "pa".player_api_id, "pa".preferred_foot FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" ORDER BY "pa".player_api_id ASC, "pa".date DESC) AS "latest_pa" ON "latest_pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "latest_pa".preferred_foot = 'left' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".id) AS "matches_played" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON ("p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11)) WHERE "p".player_name LIKE 'Adam%' AND "p".weight > 170 AND "m".season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY "p".player_api_id, "p".player_name ORDER BY "p".player_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "home_results" AS (SELECT "m".home_team_api_id AS "team_api_id", "m".date AS "match_date" FROM "match" AS "m" WHERE "m".home_team_goal - "m".away_team_goal >= 3), "rated_home_wins" AS (SELECT "hr".team_api_id FROM "home_results" AS "hr" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "ta".buildupplayspeedclass FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" WHERE "ta".team_api_id = "hr".team_api_id AND "ta".date <= "hr".match_date ORDER BY "ta".date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "latest_rating" ON TRUE WHERE "latest_rating".buildupplayspeedclass = 'Fast') SELECT "t".team_long_name AS "club_name", "t".team_short_name AS "short_name", COUNT(*) AS "home_win_count" FROM "rated_home_wins" AS "rhw" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "rhw".team_api_id GROUP BY "t".team_api_id, "t".team_long_name, "t".team_short_name ORDER BY home_win_count DESC, club_name ASC, short_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT season, COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS "different_players" FROM "player" INNER JOIN "match" ON "player".player_api_id IN ("match".away_player_1, "match".away_player_2, "match".away_player_3, "match".away_player_4, "match".away_player_5, "match".away_player_6, "match".away_player_7, "match".away_player_8, "match".away_player_9, "match".away_player_10, "match".away_player_11) WHERE "match".home_team_goal - "match".away_team_goal >= 5 GROUP BY season ORDER BY season ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "qualifying_players" FROM "country" AS "c" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l" ON "l".country_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".league_id = "l".id INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".home_team_api_id OR "t".team_api_id = "m".away_team_api_id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".weight >= 210 GROUP BY "c".name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) = (SELECT MAX(player_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p2".player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "country" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l2" ON "l2".country_id = "c2".id INNER JOIN "match" AS "m2" ON "m2".league_id = "l2".id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p2" ON "p2".player_api_id IN ("m2".home_player_1, "m2".home_player_2, "m2".home_player_3, "m2".home_player_4, "m2".home_player_5, "m2".home_player_6, "m2".home_player_7, "m2".home_player_8, "m2".home_player_9, "m2".home_player_10, "m2".home_player_11, "m2".away_player_1, "m2".away_player_2, "m2".away_player_3, "m2".away_player_4, "m2".away_player_5, "m2".away_player_6, "m2".away_player_7, "m2".away_player_8, "m2".away_player_9, "m2".away_player_10, "m2".away_player_11) WHERE "p2".weight >= 210 GROUP BY "c2".name) AS "counts") ORDER BY "c".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".season, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "player_count", ROUND(AVG("p".height)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l" ON "l".id = "m".league_id INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "l".country_id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "c".name = 'Italy' AND "m".season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016') GROUP BY "m".season ORDER BY "m".season ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("pa".player_api_id) "pa".player_api_id, "pa".volleys FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" ORDER BY "pa".player_api_id ASC, "pa".date DESC, "pa".id DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest" AS "l" ON "l".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height > 180 AND "l".volleys > 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(player_goal_total), 2) AS "average_total_home_goals" FROM (SELECT "m".home_player_3 AS "player_api_id", SUM("m".home_team_goal) AS "player_goal_total" FROM "match" AS "m" WHERE "m".home_player_3 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "m".home_player_3) AS "player_totals" LIMIT 501

WITH "match_players" AS (SELECT country_id, player_api_id FROM (SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS "player_api_id" FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM "match") AS "u" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, player_api_id FROM (SELECT country_id, home_player_9 AS "player_api_id" FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM "match") AS "u" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, player_api_id FROM (SELECT country_id, away_player_6 AS "player_api_id" FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM "match" UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM "match") AS "u"), "counts" AS (SELECT "c".name AS "country_name", COUNT(*) AS "player_appearances" FROM "match_players" AS "mp" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "mp".player_api_id INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "mp".country_id WHERE "p".weight <= 160 GROUP BY "c".name) SELECT country_name FROM "counts" WHERE player_appearances = (SELECT MIN(player_appearances) FROM "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date <= '2015-01-01' ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC) AS "latest" WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium') LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("pa".player_api_id) "pa".player_api_id, "pa".preferred_foot, "pa".attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" ORDER BY "pa".player_api_id ASC, "pa".date DESC, "pa".id DESC), "left_footed_with_rate" AS (SELECT preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate FROM "latest" WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attacking_work_rate = 'low') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "left_footed_with_rate" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".id) AS "matches_played" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".season = '2015/2016' AND ("p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11) OR "p".player_api_id IN ("m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11)) WHERE "p".player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND TO_DATE("p".birthday, 'YYYY-MM-DD') > DATE '1990-12-31' GROUP BY "p".player_api_id, "p".player_name ORDER BY "p".player_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "pa".player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" WHERE "pa".jumping >= 80 AND "pa".date >= '2007-02-22' AND "pa".date < '2007-08-31' LIMIT 501

SELECT "ta"."buildupplayspeedclass" FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON ("t".team_api_id = "m".home_team_api_id OR "t".team_api_id = "m".away_team_api_id) INNER JOIN "team_attributes" AS "ta" ON "ta".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id WHERE "t".team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge' AND "m".season = '2012/2013' AND "m".date = (SELECT MAX("m2".date) FROM "match" AS "m2" WHERE "m2".season = '2012/2013' AND ("m2".home_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id OR "m2".away_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id)) AND "ta".date = (SELECT MAX("ta2".date) FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta2" WHERE "ta2".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id AND "ta2".date <= "m".date) LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(("d".overall_rating - "a".avg_rating) * 100.0 / "a".avg_rating, 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT overall_rating FROM "player_attributes" WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM "player" WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan' LIMIT 1) AND date <= '2013-07-12 23:59:59' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "d" CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS "avg_rating" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, overall_rating FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date <= '2013-07-12 23:59:59' AND defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') AND overall_rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC, id DESC) AS "p") AS "a" LIMIT 501

WITH "lowest_salary" AS (SELECT MIN(a11) AS "salary" FROM "district"), "salary_range" AS (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) AS "salary_difference" FROM "district") SELECT "a".account_id, "sr".salary_difference FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id CROSS JOIN "salary_range" AS "sr" WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "d".a11 = (SELECT salary FROM "lowest_salary") AND "c".birth_date = (SELECT MIN("c2".birth_date) FROM "client" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "c2".district_id WHERE "c2".gender = 'F' AND "d2".a11 = (SELECT salary FROM "lowest_salary")) LIMIT 501

SELECT "district".a2 FROM "client" INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".client_id = "client".client_id INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "disp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "account".district_id WHERE "client".gender = 'F' AND "client".birth_date = DATE '1976-01-29' AND "disp".type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 501

WITH "target" AS (SELECT district_id FROM "district" WHERE a3 = 'south Bohemia' ORDER BY a8 DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".gender = 'M') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "male_percentage" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "target" AS "t" ON "c".district_id = "t".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * ("last_balance".balance - "first_balance".balance) / NULLIF("first_balance".balance, 0) AS "percentage_increase" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date = DATE '1993-03-22' ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "first_balance" ON TRUE INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date = DATE '1998-12-27' ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "last_balance" ON TRUE WHERE "l".date = DATE '1993-07-05' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".frequency FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '2001-01-01' AND "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT "disp".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "disp".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "disp" INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "disp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "account".district_id WHERE "disp".type <> 'OWNER' AND "district".a11 > 8000 AND "district".a11 <= 9000 GROUP BY "disp".type LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1997 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1996 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1996 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "percentage_growth" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "l".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 AND "o".amount = 3539 LIMIT 501

WITH "first_month" AS (SELECT MIN("date") AS "earliest_date" FROM "account"), "districts_opened" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a"."district_id" FROM "account" AS "a" CROSS JOIN "first_month" AS "f" WHERE "a"."date" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', "f".earliest_date)::DATE AND "a"."date" < (DATE_TRUNC('month', "f".earliest_date) + INTERVAL '1 month')::DATE), "populations" AS (SELECT "d"."district_id", "d"."a2" AS "district", "d"."a4"::BIGINT AS "population" FROM "districts_opened" AS "o" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "o"."district_id") SELECT district, population FROM "populations" WHERE population = (SELECT MAX(population) FROM "populations") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976 AND "t".k_symbol = ' ' LIMIT 501

WITH "top_districts" AS (SELECT district_id, a2, a4, a8 AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" ORDER BY a8 DESC LIMIT 5), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "td".district_id, "td".a2, "td".a4, "td".inhabitants, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count", COALESCE(SUM("l".amount) FILTER (WHERE "l".status IN ('C', 'D')), 0) AS "active_loan_amount" FROM "top_districts" AS "td" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "td".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "td".district_id, "td".a2, "td".a4, "td".inhabitants), "averages" AS (SELECT district_id, a2, a4, ROUND(active_loan_amount::NUMERIC / NULLIF(account_count, 0)) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM "district_stats") SELECT a2 AS "district_name", average_active_loan_per_account FROM "averages" ORDER BY average_active_loan_per_account DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "regional_totals" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_approved_amount" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month')) > DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY "d".a3) SELECT region, total_approved_amount FROM "regional_totals" WHERE total_approved_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_approved_amount) FROM "regional_totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "branch_district".district_id, "branch_district".a11 FROM "district" AS "branch_district" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "branch_district".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "branch_district".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') SELECT ROUND(AVG(a11), 2) AS "average_salary", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM "eligible_districts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_average_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "home_district" ON "home_district".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' WHERE "home_district".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "disp" AS "account_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id WHERE "account_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id)) AS "qualifying_districts" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "qualifying_districts".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "eligible_accounts" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "eligible_accounts".account_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> ' ' AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') AS "cohort_accounts" ON "cohort_accounts".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".amount > 4000 LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date, SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date), "owners" AS (SELECT "d".account_id, "c".district_id AS "home_district_id" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER'), "counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".account) AS "outside_counterparty_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id), "household_data" AS (SELECT "b".account_id, "b".date, "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".outside_counterparty_count, 0) AS "outside_counterparty_count", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a11 AS "district_population" FROM "borrowing_accounts" AS "b" INNER JOIN "owners" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "b".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "o".home_district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "b".account_id) SELECT account_id, date, total_borrowed, outside_counterparty_count, owner_home_district, district_population, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "household_data" ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT "t".account_id FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id HAVING AVG("t".balance) > 1000), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a13 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" ON "qa".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "d".a8 > 100000), "stats" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants", ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_urban_ratio" FROM "qualifying_districts" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' ELSE 'men' END AS "gender", "s".district_count, "qd".district_id, "s".max_inhabitants AS "inhabitants", "s".average_salary, "s".average_urban_ratio FROM "stats" AS "s" INNER JOIN "qualifying_districts" AS "qd" ON "qd".gender = "s".gender AND "qd".inhabitants = "s".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, "qd".district_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol <> ' ' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("d".a13)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate", (ARRAY_AGG("d".a2 ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC, "d".a2 ASC))[1] AS "most_populous_district" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F') AS "eligible" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "eligible".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2, CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, LOWER("d".a2) ASC LIMIT 3), "counts" AS (SELECT "r".district_id, "r".a2, "r".inhabitants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = "r".district_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01') AS "crime_count" FROM "ranked" AS "r"), "overall" AS (SELECT AVG("x".crime_count::NUMERIC) AS "overall_avg" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "crime_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id) AS "x") SELECT "c".a2 AS "district_name", "c".crime_count, ROUND(AVG("c".crime_count::NUMERIC) OVER (), 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND("o".overall_avg, 2) AS "all_district_average", ROUND(AVG("c".crime_count::NUMERIC) OVER () - "o".overall_avg, 2) AS "average_difference" FROM "counts" AS "c" CROSS JOIN "overall" AS "o" ORDER BY "c".inhabitants DESC, LOWER("c".a2) ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "districts_by_type" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "card"."type" AS "card_type", "district".a2 AS "home_district", "district".a4 AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" INNER JOIN "disp" ON "card".disp_id = "disp".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" ON "disp".client_id = "client".client_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "client".district_id = "district".district_id), "minima" AS (SELECT card_type, MIN(inhabitants::BIGINT) AS "inhabitants" FROM "districts_by_type" GROUP BY card_type) SELECT "districts_by_type".card_type, "districts_by_type".home_district, "minima".inhabitants FROM "districts_by_type" INNER JOIN "minima" ON "districts_by_type".card_type = "minima".card_type AND "districts_by_type".inhabitants::BIGINT = "minima".inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "districts_by_type".card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, "districts_by_type".home_district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_balances" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, "t".balance FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".a2 = 'Litomerice' AND "home".a3 = "d".a3 INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "tr".balance FROM "trans" AS "tr" WHERE "tr".account_id = "a".account_id AND "tr".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY "tr".date DESC, "tr".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "t" ON TRUE WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "district_averages" AS (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", AVG("ab".balance::NUMERIC) AS "avg_balance" FROM "account_balances" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ab".district_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2) SELECT district_name AS "district_with_highest_average_end_of_1996_balance", ROUND(avg_balance, 2) AS "average_end_of_1996_balance" FROM "district_averages" ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "top_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "a".district_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "selected_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", "d".a12 AS "average_salary" FROM "top_loans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "t".district_id WHERE "t".rn <= 10) SELECT (SELECT district_id FROM "selected_districts" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "district_id", (SELECT inhabitants FROM "selected_districts" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "inhabitants", ROUND(AVG(average_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "selected_districts" LIMIT 501

WITH "withdrawals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "standing_orders" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("o".amount) AS "total_standing_order_debit" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id), "district_metrics" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "w".total_withdrawn, "w".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "d".a4::NUMERIC AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", "so".total_standing_order_debit::NUMERIC / "account_counts".account_count AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "withdrawals" AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "standing_orders" AS "so" ON "so".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" GROUP BY district_id) AS "account_counts" ON "account_counts".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank", ROUND(average_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district_metrics" ORDER BY rank ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "client_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" WHERE "d".client_id = 3541), "transaction_stats" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'PRIJEM' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'VYDAJ' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "client_accounts" AS "ca" ON "ca".account_id = "t".account_id GROUP BY "t".account_id), "region_client_counts" AS (SELECT "hd".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "hd" ON "hd".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "hd".a3), "regional_population_ranks" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC) AS "population_rank", FIRST_VALUE("d".a2) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC, "d".district_id ASC) AS "most_populous_district", FIRST_VALUE("d".a8) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC, "d".district_id ASC) AS "most_populous_inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d") SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opened_date", "a".frequency, "ad".a2 AS "district_name", "ad".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "ad".district_id = "hc".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_client_home_district", "ad".a11 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("ts".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("ts".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("ts".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("ts".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "rcc".client_count AS "clients_in_region", "rpr".most_populous_district, "rpr".most_populous_inhabitants, "rpr".population_rank AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "client_accounts" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ca".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ad" ON "ad".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "hc_client" ON "hc_client".client_id = 3541 INNER JOIN "district" AS "hc" ON "hc".district_id = "hc_client".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_stats" AS "ts" ON "ts".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "region_client_counts" AS "rcc" ON "rcc".region = "ad".a3 INNER JOIN "regional_population_ranks" AS "rpr" ON "rpr".district_id = "ad".district_id ORDER BY COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date) AS "opening_year", "al".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("al".amount_lent) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date), "al".district_id) SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(opening_year::TEXT, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY') AS "opening_year", SUM(accounts_opened) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG(amount_lent::NUMERIC / accounts_opened), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "district_year" GROUP BY opening_year ORDER BY opening_year ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_loans" AS (SELECT loan_id, account_id, amount, date FROM "ranked_loans" WHERE loan_rank <= 10), "last_day_transactions" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, "t".date, "t".balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t".account_id, "t".date ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC) AS "trans_rank" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "top_loans" AS "tl" ON "tl".account_id = "t".account_id AND "tl".date = "t".date) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "tl".amount AS "approved_amount", "tl".date AS "approval_date", "ldt".balance AS "account_balance" FROM "top_loans" AS "tl" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "tl".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "last_day_transactions" AS "ldt" ON "ldt".account_id = "tl".account_id AND "ldt".date = "tl".date AND "ldt".trans_rank = 1 ORDER BY "tl".amount DESC, "tl".date ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_clients" AS (SELECT "cl".client_id, "cl".gender, "cl".birth_date, "ca"."type" AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cl".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", "dp".account_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id LEFT JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "client_accounts" AS (SELECT client_id, account_id FROM "card_clients" GROUP BY client_id, account_id), "client_loans" AS (SELECT "ca".client_id, COUNT("l".loan_id) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "client_accounts" AS "ca" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "ca".account_id GROUP BY "ca".client_id) SELECT "cc".client_id, "cc".gender, "cc".birth_date, "cc".card_type, "cc".age_at_issue, "cln".number_of_loans, "cln".total_amount_borrowed, CASE WHEN "cln".number_of_loans > 0 AND "cc".age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN "cln".number_of_loans > 0 AND "cc".age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "cc".district_name, "cc".district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "cc".gender ORDER BY "cc".age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card_clients" AS "cc" INNER JOIN "client_loans" AS "cln" ON "cln".client_id = "cc".client_id ORDER BY "cc".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol = ' ' GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".loan_id = 98832 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, "t".bank ASC, "t".account ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "active_loan_account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM "disp" WHERE client_id = 2823) AS "client_accounts" ON "client_accounts".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "female_loans" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "l".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "account_activity" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "female_loans" AS "f" ON "f".account_id = "t".account_id AND "f".loan_rank <= 3 GROUP BY "t".account_id), "region_loan_counts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "region_salary_avgs" AS (SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) SELECT "f".client_id, "f".amount AS "loan_amount", "f".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND(("f".payments * "f".duration)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("f".payments * "f".duration - "f".amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "interest_paid", "f".status AS "loan_status", "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("aa".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("aa".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("aa".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "f".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("aa".total_deposits, 0) > "f".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rlc".loan_count AS "regional_loan_count", "rsa".average_district_salary, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '2026-10-09') - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "f".birth_date) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("f".birth_date, 'MMDD') > '1009' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "completed_age" FROM "female_loans" AS "f" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "f".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "account_activity" AS "aa" ON "aa".account_id = "f".account_id INNER JOIN "region_loan_counts" AS "rlc" ON "rlc".region = "d".a3 INNER JOIN "region_salary_avgs" AS "rsa" ON "rsa".region = "d".a3 WHERE "f".loan_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "f".amount DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".account_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "c".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "totals" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE((SELECT SUM("t".amount) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE((SELECT SUM("t".amount) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".account_id = "a".account_id) AS "number_of_loans", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "ga" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ga".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id) SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_amount_received, total_amount_withdrawn, number_of_loans, external_counterparties, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS "rank" FROM "totals" ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 100

"disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "ca".disp_id WHERE "cd".account_id = "a".account_id AND "ca".issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'), 0) AS "card_count", COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "peak_balance_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id AND "o".type = 'OWNER' INNER SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".position = 1 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "seasonal_totals" AS (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, MAX("cs".points) AS "season_points" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid GROUP BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year), "career" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("st".season_points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "seasonal_totals" AS "st" ON "st".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "career") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "r".rank = 1 THEN "c".constructorid END) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "pitstops" AS "p" WHERE "p".raceid IN (SELECT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19 AND "ds".raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM "races" WHERE year = "r".year))) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 > '2:00.000' LIMIT 501

WITH "september_stops" AS (SELECT "p".milliseconds, "p".duration, "p".raceid, "p".driverid, "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01'), "fastest" AS (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) AS "min_milliseconds" FROM "september_stops") SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "s".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "s".race_name, "s".circuit_name, "s".circuit_location FROM "september_stops" AS "s" INNER JOIN "fastest" AS "f" ON "s".milliseconds = "f".min_milliseconds INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "s".driverid = "d".driverid LIMIT 501

WITH "winners" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob, "d".nationality FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "chosen" AS (SELECT * FROM "winners" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "ra".name, "ra".date FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "chosen" AS "c" ON "c".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "ra".date ASC, "ra".name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "c".forename || ' ' || "c".surname AS "full_name", "c".nationality, "fw".name AS "first_race_won", "fw".date AS "first_win_date", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "res".driverid = "c".driverid AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) AS "races_started" FROM "chosen" AS "c" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "c".country = 'Canada' AND "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name AS "constructor_name" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "q".constructorid = "c".constructorid LEFT JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "q".raceid AND "res".driverid = "q".driverid AND "res".constructorid = "q".constructorid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q2 ASC, "res".grid ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

WITH "q2_ranked" AS (SELECT "q".driverid, "q".raceid, "q".q2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "q".raceid ORDER BY "q".q2 ASC) AS "rn" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL), "fastest" AS (SELECT MIN(q2) AS "q2" FROM "q2_ranked" WHERE rn = 1) SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "q2_ranked" AS "x" INNER JOIN "fastest" AS "f" ON "x".q2 = "f".q2 INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "x".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "x".raceid WHERE "x".rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC * 1000) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC * 1000) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "editions" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".year, "r".time AS "start_time", (SELECT "res".time FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position = 2 LIMIT 1) AS "runner_up_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009) SELECT year, runner_up_gap FROM "editions" WHERE start_time = (SELECT MIN(start_time) FROM "editions") ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 < '1:38.000' LIMIT 501

SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "c".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "c".circuitref ASC) FILTER (WHERE "r".time = (SELECT MIN(time) FROM "races")) AS "earliest_circuitref", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "c".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "c".circuitref ASC) FILTER (WHERE "r".time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM "races")) AS "latest_circuitref", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("r".time::TIME) - MIN("r".time::TIME))) AS "gap_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND "r".fastestlapspeed <> '' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob ORDER BY MAX("r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 IS NULL ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "st" ON "st".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "st".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".position IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "x".link_to_member INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "x".link_to_budget WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "x".expense_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "x".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_expenses" LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501
SELECT (150::NUMERIC / 55) AS "ratio" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, SUM("b".spent) AS "total_spending", SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budget_amount" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "ratios" AS (SELECT event_id, event_name, total_spending / NULLIF(total_budget_amount, 0) AS "spending_ratio" FROM "event_totals") SELECT event_name FROM "ratios" WHERE spending_ratio = (SELECT MAX(spending_ratio) FROM "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501
SELECT 17 AS "soccer_head_count", 16.1 AS "fall_2019_average", 'more' AS "verdict" LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".department, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT "m".major_name ORDER BY "m".major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT "m".major_name ORDER BY "m".major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE("counts".member_count, 0) > 0), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("counts".member_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM (SELECT major_id, major_name, department, college FROM "major" WHERE department IN (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences')) AS "m" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "member" GROUP BY link_to_major) AS "counts" ON "counts".link_to_major = "m".major_id GROUP BY "m".department ORDER BY "m".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e"."type" AS "event_type", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e2" ON "a".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2"."type" = "e"."type" AND "e2".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e2".event_date < '2020-01-01') AS "members_attended", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e3" ON "b".link_to_event = "e3".event_id WHERE "e3"."type" = "e"."type" AND "e3".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e3".event_date < '2020-01-01') AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e"."type" ORDER BY "e"."type" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "maj".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "maj" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "maj".major_id AND "m".position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "attendance") AS "attended" ON "attended".link_to_member = "m".member_id LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "m".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "maj".college = 'College of Engineering' AND ("attended".link_to_member IS NOT NULL OR "m".member_id IS NULL) GROUP BY "maj".department ORDER BY "maj".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues_dollars" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "e".type = 'Game' AND "e".location = 'Campus Football stadium' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "majors_with_no_enrolled_members" FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college = (SELECT "m2".college FROM "member" AS "tm" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "tm".link_to_major = "m2".major_id WHERE "tm".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "tm".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" WHERE "enrolled".link_to_major = "m".major_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "b".category = 'Advertisement' LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

WITH "counts" AS (SELECT "maj".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "maj" ON "maj".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "maj".major_name), "ranked" AS (SELECT major_name, attendee_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY attendee_count DESC) AS "rank" FROM "counts") SELECT major_name, attendee_count FROM "ranked" WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m"."link_to_major" = "ma"."major_id")) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" AS "ma" LIMIT 501

SELECT group_name, ROUND(AVG(events_attended::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END AS "group_name", COALESCE("a".event_count, 0) AS "events_attended", CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS "sort_order" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_member) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id) AS "member_attendance" GROUP BY group_name, sort_order ORDER BY sort_order ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "over_budget_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "ev".event_id = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".amount - "b".spent < 0 AND "ev".event_date::DATE >= (SELECT MIN(event_date::DATE) FROM "event") AND "ev".event_date::DATE < (SELECT MAX(event_date::DATE) + 1 FROM "event")), "split_kinds" AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN expense_description IN ('Water, Cookies', 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies', 'Water, chips, cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips') THEN 'Water' WHEN expense_description = 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 'Bakery' WHEN expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' THEN 'Post Cards' ELSE expense_description END AS "kind" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget INNER JOIN "over_budget_events" AS "o" ON "o".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN expense_description IN ('Water, Cookies', 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies', 'Water, chips, cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips') THEN 'Cookies' WHEN expense_description = 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 'Donuts' WHEN expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' THEN 'Posters' WHEN expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' THEN 'Veggie tray' WHEN expense_description IN ('Water, chips, cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips') THEN 'chips' ELSE NULL END AS "kind" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget INNER JOIN "over_budget_events" AS "o" ON "o".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN expense_description = 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 'muffins' WHEN expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' THEN 'supplies' WHEN expense_description IN ('Water, chips, cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips') THEN 'cookies' ELSE NULL END AS "kind" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget INNER JOIN "over_budget_events" AS "o" ON "o".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT kind) AS "count" FROM "split_kinds" WHERE kind IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT event_name, amount_spent_per_attendee FROM (SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_spend, 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member), 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "budget".link_to_event, SUM("expense".cost) AS "water_spend" FROM "budget" INNER JOIN "expense" ON "expense".link_to_budget = "budget".budget_id WHERE "expense".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "budget".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "w".water_spend) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'major in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' ELSE 'do not major in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' END AS "group_name", COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "member" LEFT JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'major in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' ELSE 'do not major in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' END LIMIT 501

WITH "chip_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".link_to_event FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%'), "event_max" AS (SELECT "ce".link_to_event, MAX("b".amount) AS "largest_line" FROM "chip_events" AS "ce" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ce".link_to_event GROUP BY "ce".link_to_event) SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event_max" AS "em" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "em".link_to_event WHERE "em".largest_line = (SELECT MAX(largest_line) FROM "event_max") LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT MAX("e".expense_date) AS "expense_date" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President') SELECT "latest".expense_date, SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "latest" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".expense_date = "latest".expense_date GROUP BY "latest".expense_date ORDER BY "latest".expense_date DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".college, COUNT(*) AS "major_count" FROM "member" AS "me" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "me".link_to_major = "m".major_id GROUP BY "m".college HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(college_major_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "college_major_count" FROM "member" AS "me2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "me2".link_to_major = "m2".major_id GROUP BY "m2".college) AS "counts") ORDER BY "m".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "pb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "pb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "pb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "pizza_events" ON "pizza_events".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < DATE '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "purchase_counts" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event AS "event_id", COUNT("ex".expense_id) AS "purchase_records" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) SELECT "et".event_name FROM "event_totals" AS "et" LEFT JOIN "purchase_counts" AS "pc" ON "pc".event_id = "et".event_id WHERE "et".total_spending <= "et".total_budget ORDER BY COALESCE("pc".purchase_records, 0) DESC, "et".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "type_counts" AS (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type), "ranked" AS (SELECT type, member_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY member_count DESC) AS "r" FROM "type_counts") SELECT type, member_count FROM "ranked" WHERE r = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "b".category, "e".expense_description AS "item_name", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "v" ON "b".link_to_event = "v".event_id WHERE "v".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' GROUP BY "b".category, "e".expense_description ORDER BY "b".category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE("b".total_amount_budgeted, 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COALESCE("a".number_of_members_attended, 0) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_budgeted" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "expense".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "purchase_count" FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "member" ON "expense".link_to_member = "member".member_id WHERE "member".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "member".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "expense".expense_description LIMIT 501

WITH "item_counts" AS (SELECT "e".link_to_member, SUM(CASE WHEN "e".expense_description IN ('Water, Cookies', 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins', 'Post Cards, Posters') THEN 2 WHEN "e".expense_description IN ('Water, Veggie tray, supplies', 'Water, chips, cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips') THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) AS "kind_count", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_spending" FROM "expense" AS "e" WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".link_to_member), "ranked" AS (SELECT *, MAX(kind_count) OVER () AS "max_kind_count" FROM "item_counts") SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", "r".kind_count AS "different_kinds_count", "r".total_spending AS "total_spending_dollars" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "r".link_to_member WHERE "r".kind_count = "r".max_kind_count LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_name) FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

WITH "colour_counts" AS (SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' GROUP BY "c".colour) SELECT eye_colour, hero_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hero_count DESC) AS "rank" FROM "colour_counts" ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 501
