SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".publisher_name, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p".publisher_name LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' ORDER BY "s".full_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "skin".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "eye".colour IS NOT NULL AND "hair".colour IS NOT NULL AND "skin".colour IS NOT NULL AND "eye".colour = "hair".colour AND "hair".colour = "skin".colour LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "dc".hero_count > "marvel".hero_count THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN "marvel".hero_count > "dc".hero_count THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS("dc".hero_count - "marvel".hero_count) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT COUNT("s".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc" CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT("s".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "dc_hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "dc_hp" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "dc_s" ON "dc_s".id = "dc_hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_p" ON "dc_p".id = "dc_s".publisher_id WHERE "dc_p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_powers" ON "dc_powers".power_id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "dc_powers".power_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "hp"."power_id" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "strength_hp" ON "strength_hp"."hero_id" = "hp"."hero_id" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "strength_sp" ON "strength_sp"."id" = "strength_hp"."power_id" WHERE "strength_sp"."power_name" = 'Super Strength' GROUP BY "hp"."power_id" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp"."hero_id") = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "all_hp"."hero_id") FROM "hero_power" AS "all_hp" WHERE "all_hp"."power_id" = "hp"."power_id")) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_heroes" AS (SELECT "s".id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> ''), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "ep".hero_id) AS "hero_count" FROM "eligible_heroes" AS "eh" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "ep" ON "ep".hero_id = "eh".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "ep".power_id GROUP BY "sp".power_name) SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM "power_counts" WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM "power_counts") ORDER BY power_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_ab".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_ab" ON "ha_ab".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_ab" ON "a_ab".id = "ha_ab".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a_ab".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT "u".gender, "u".superhero_count FROM (SELECT "g".gender, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'blue' AND "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" GROUP BY "hp".hero_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10) GROUP BY "g".gender UNION ALL SELECT "g".gender, 0 AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "s".gender_id = "g".id AND "c".colour ILIKE 'blue' AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" GROUP BY "hp".hero_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10))) AS "u" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg)::NUMERIC)::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "hulk_ha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_ha" ON "hulk_ha".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "hulk_a" ON "hulk_a".id = "hulk_ha".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "hulk_a".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "tenth_height" AS (SELECT height_cm FROM "superhero" ORDER BY height_cm DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9), "tallest" AS (SELECT id FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm >= (SELECT height_cm FROM "tenth_height")) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "tallest" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "tallest".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "character" ON "character".publisher_id = "target".publisher_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND "character".race_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "hero_counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "cryo_holders" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis'), "shared_power_heroes" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".power_id IN (SELECT "hp_cryo".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp_cryo" INNER JOIN "cryo_holders" AS "ch" ON "ch".hero_id = "hp_cryo".hero_id)), "hero_power_counts" AS (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG("hpc".power_count)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_superpowers" FROM "shared_power_heroes" AS "sph" INNER JOIN "hero_power_counts" AS "hpc" ON "hpc".hero_id = "sph".hero_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_p" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dc_p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "marvel".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "marvel_p" ON "marvel".publisher_id = "marvel_p".id WHERE "marvel_p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "shared_eye" ON "shared_eye".eye_colour_id = "dc".eye_colour_id WHERE "dc_p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id WHERE "r".race = (SELECT "r2".race FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "s2".race_id = "r2".id WHERE "s2".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "female_hero" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "female_hero".gender_id WHERE "female_hero".race_id = "s".race_id AND "g".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT("s".weight_kg) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "target_hero".id) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "target_hero" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "blackwulf" ON "blackwulf".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other_publisher_hero" ON "other_publisher_hero".eye_colour_id = "target_hero".eye_colour_id AND "other_publisher_hero".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "other_publisher_hero".publisher_id <> "target_hero".publisher_id WHERE "target_hero".publisher_id = "blackwulf".publisher_id AND "target_hero".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "target".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "target".full_name = 'Charles Chandler' GROUP BY "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "target2" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s2" ON "s2".publisher_id = "target2".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id WHERE "target2".full_name = 'Charles Chandler' GROUP BY "r2".race) AS "race_counts") ORDER BY "r".race ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("p".power_count, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name ~ '[[:space:]]' GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name ILIKE '%George Lucas%' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour ILIKE 'green' AND "sp".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm = (SELECT MIN("s2".height_cm) FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "s2".race_id = "r2".id WHERE "r2".race = 'Human' AND "s2".height_cm IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "largest_superpower_count" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY "s".id) AS "hero_power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colour".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_colour" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair_colour".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour".id WHERE "eye_colour".id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "brown_hero".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "brown_hero" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "brown_hair" ON "brown_hero".hair_colour_id = "brown_hair".id WHERE "brown_hair".colour = 'Brown') AND ("hair_colour".colour <> 'Brown' OR "hair_colour".colour IS NULL) GROUP BY "eye_colour".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "eye_colour".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> 'N/A' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".hero_id = "target".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "shared_power" ON "shared_power".power_id = "target_power".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".id = "shared_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".id <> "target".id AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "l".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "l".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".description IS NULL AND "l".crp LIKE '%+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory") AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest_rnp" AS (SELECT "rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' ORDER BY "rnp"::INTEGER DESC LIMIT 1), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l"."date", "l"."id", "p"."sex", "p"."birthday" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" WHERE "l"."rnp" = (SELECT "rnp" FROM "strongest_rnp") AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "T-BIL", "date", "id", "sex", "birthday" FROM "candidates" WHERE "T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM "candidates") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."birthday" > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "p"."id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "examination") AND "p"."id" NOT IN (SELECT "l"."id" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE CASE "l"."rnp" WHEN '15' THEN 15 WHEN '16' THEN 16 WHEN '64' THEN 64 WHEN '256' THEN 256 ELSE 0 END > 10) LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')), "patient_titers" AS (SELECT "e".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "rnp_titer" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id) SELECT id, rnp_titer FROM "patient_titers" WHERE rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(rnp_titer) FROM "patient_titers") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".test_date_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "test_date_count" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, dna, MAX(dna::NUMERIC) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS "highest_level" FROM "eligible") SELECT id, date, dna FROM "ranked" WHERE dna::NUMERIC = highest_level ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "overlap_patients" AS (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis LIKE '%RA%' AND diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%' AND diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%' AND replace(replace(replace(replace(diagnosis, 'RA', ''), 'SJS', ''), ',', ''), ' ', '') = ''), "platelet_status" AS (SELECT "p".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "has_normal" FROM "overlap_patients" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id GROUP BY "p".id) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_normal = 1) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_normal = 0) AS "patients_without_normal_platelet" FROM "platelet_status" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 AND "l".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_rnp" AS (SELECT "p".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "has_result", MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "elevated" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' GROUP BY "p".id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(elevated)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(has_result), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient_rnp" WHERE has_result = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 32 GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l"."date")::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".id IS NULL THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE "thrombosis" = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("first_exam".first_exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" GROUP BY id) AS "first_exam" ON "first_exam".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000', '>=300.0') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_out_of_range_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = "p".admission) ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_max" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p"."First Date") = 1991 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' GROUP BY "l".id), "overall_max" AS (SELECT MAX(max_rnp) AS "max_rnp" FROM "patient_max") SELECT "pm".id, "pm".max_rnp AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "patient_max" AS "pm" INNER JOIN "overall_max" AS "om" ON "pm".max_rnp = "om".max_rnp ORDER BY "pm".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND hct IS NOT NULL AND ("U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "U-PRO" = '+2(100)' OR "U-PRO" = '+1(30)') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+')) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".id IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".id HAVING MAX("l".date) > DATE '1997-01-01') AND (SELECT "l".sc170 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) ORDER BY "l".sc170 ASC LIMIT 1) IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) FROM (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AS "s" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" <> '-') AS "u" ON "s".id = "u".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "rnp"::INTEGER END) FROM "laboratory" WHERE "cre" < 1.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256')), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, rnp, MAX(rnp::INTEGER) OVER () AS "max_rnp" FROM "eligible") SELECT id AS "patient identification", date AS "laboratory test date", rnp AS "anti-ribonuclear protein reading" FROM "ranked" WHERE rnp::INTEGER = max_rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "normal-range lactate dehydrogenase measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "l".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN NULL ELSE "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "highest_rnp_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "p".id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE hgb < 10) GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN NULL ELSE "l".rnp::INTEGER END) = (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp <> 'negative') LIMIT 501

WITH "first_records" AS (SELECT id, got, rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date ASC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory") SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "first_records" WHERE rn = 1 AND got < 60 AND rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "latest".date, "latest"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" <> '') AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id WHERE "latest".rn = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp <> '0' AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')), "patient_max" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "max_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id GROUP BY "l".id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".gpt IS NULL OR "l".gpt >= 60) = 0) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient_max" AS "m" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "m".id ORDER BY "m".max_gpt DESC, "m".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l"."date", "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l"."date" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "patients" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "elevated" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256')) SELECT "p".care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_elevated_rnp_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_elevated_rnp_result" FROM "patients" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "elevated" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id GROUP BY "p".care_setting ORDER BY "p".care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) AND "l".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_max" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) AS "highest_dna", (ARRAY_AGG("l".dna ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC))[1] AS "highest_as_written" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, diagnosis, highest_dna, highest_as_written, MAX(highest_dna) OVER () AS "overall_max" FROM "patient_max") SELECT id, diagnosis, highest_as_written FROM "ranked" WHERE highest_dna = overall_max LIMIT 501

WITH "settings" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')), "most_recent" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT "s".setting AS "setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "mr".igg > 900 AND "mr".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "settings" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "most_recent" AS "mr" ON "mr".id = "s".id GROUP BY "s".setting ORDER BY "s".setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_visits" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_results" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest_visits" AS "v" ON "l".id = "v".id AND "l".date = "v".latest_date), "counts" AS (SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_results" AS "r" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "r".rnp IN ('32', '64', '256') GROUP BY "p".sex) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(patient_count) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F'), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(patient_count) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'M'), 0) AS "female_minus_male" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_lab" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM "latest_lab" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '+') AS "inpatient_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '-') AS "outpatient_count", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" ~ '(^|[, ]+)SLE([, ]|$)' AND "diagnosis" !~ 'SLE susp' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ldh >= 500) AS "high_ldh" ON "high_ldh".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "proteinuria" ON "proteinuria".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms <> '' ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC NULLS LAST, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC NULLS LAST, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".admission, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')) AS "eligible_patients" GROUP BY admission ORDER BY admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l_sm" ON "l_sm".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l_pro" ON "l_pro".id = "p".id WHERE "l_sm".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "l_pro"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', 'TR') AND ("l_pro"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') OR ("l_pro"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l_pro"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 30)) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc IS NOT NULL AND (rbc <= 3.5 OR rbc >= 6.0) GROUP BY id) AS "abnormal" ON "abnormal".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 0 GROUP BY id) AS "positive" ON "positive".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F' OR "p".sex = 'M'), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("l".date, 'MMDD') < TO_CHAR("p".birthday, 'MMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 50 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) AS "molecule_single_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f') THEN "m".molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "p".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "p" WHERE "p".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

WITH "single_bond_molecules" AS (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "chlorine_atom_percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "single_bond_molecules" AS "s" ON "a".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*)) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" AND "b"."bond_type" <> '-') THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'not every bond is a single bond' END AS "bond_group", SUM(CASE WHEN "m"."label" = '+' THEN 1 WHEN "m"."label" = '-' THEN -1 END) AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" GROUP BY CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" AND "b"."bond_type" <> '-') THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'not every bond is a single bond' END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a1".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "x" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "y" ON "x".molecule_id = "y".molecule_id WHERE "y".label = '+'), 2) AS "percentage_of_all_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."atom_id2") FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id" WHERE "a"."element" = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "s".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "s".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "neighbor" ON "c".atom_id2 = "neighbor".atom_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "n" ON "n".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "n".element = 'n' WHERE "m".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT "n2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "n2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "n2".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "n2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "n2".molecule_id WHERE "n2".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "chlorine".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "molecule".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "molecule".molecule_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT "molecule".molecule_id)) OVER (), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" INNER JOIN "bond" ON "bond".molecule_id = "molecule".molecule_id WHERE "bond".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "molecule".label ORDER BY "molecule".label ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON ("c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" GROUP BY "a2".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "number_of_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "number_of_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c') AS "number_of_carbon_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') AS "number_of_chlorine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "number_of_carbon_touching_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "number_of_multiple_bonds", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c') > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "yt" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".molecule_id = "yt".molecule_id AND "h".element = 'h' INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "h".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "h".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "yt".molecule_id WHERE "yt".element = 'y' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "per_atom" LIMIT 501

SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS "count_of_bonds" FROM (SELECT "a2".element AS "element", "c".bond_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element <> 'c' UNION ALL SELECT "a1".element AS "element", "c".bond_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "a1".element <> 'c') AS "u" GROUP BY element LIMIT 501

SELECT bond_type AS "bond_kind_symbol", COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element) || '|' || GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element)) FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "c".bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b2" WHERE "b2".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b2".bond_type = "b".bond_type)) AS "element_pair_count", (SELECT label FROM "molecule" WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377') AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377' AND bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "a".element HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND NOT BOOL_OR("b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element AS "element_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
